title: Country Scalloped Potatoes
description: Country scalloped potatoes recipe features potatoes layered with onion, ham, and a creamy sauce with celery soup and chicken gravy, topped with Cheddar.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Celery Soup (Regular or 98% Fat Free)
5 medium baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Stir soup, gravy, and milk together in bowl. Layer 1/2 each potatoes, onion, ham, and soup mixture in a 13x9x2-inch shallow baking dish. Repeat layers with remaining 1/2 each potatoes, onion, ham, and soup mixture. Cover dish with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes; uncover dish, continue baking 25 minutes more. Top with Cheddar cheese; bake until potatoes are tender and cheese melts, about 5 minutes more. Let stand 10 minutes.
